content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

The Agreement contains no MFN obligation of any kind. Compensation under § 3 is fixed solely by each Statement of Work on a time-and-materials basis, and no clause requires Clear Capital to extend RadialSpark terms no less favourable than those given to third parties, to disclose third-party terms, or to match competing offers. Searches across all sections for most-favoured-nation/customer, "favorable", right-to-match, other-customer comparison and exclusivity wording returned nothing running against us. The sole preferred element is met, so no redline is warranted.

One observation for other rules (not an MFN deviation): § 3(b) permits Contractor to change rates on 30 days' notice, which belongs under the pricing/rate-protection rule rather than MFN.
